content.text: {"suggestions":[{"title":"Farmhouse 'Happy Fall' Basswood Sign","summary":"A simple lean-against-the-wall wood sign with a black vinyl fall greeting, perfect for a kitchen counter or shelf.","whyItFits":"Uses your basswood sheet as a natural rustic backdrop and your black vinyl for a clean farmhouse-style word design, all cut with tools you already own.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":45,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-24","amount":1,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-01","amount":0.25,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":1,"unit":"ft"},{"supplyId":"sup-26","amount":1,"unit":"piece"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design a fall word or short phrase in your cutting software, sized to fit the 12x12 in basswood sheet.","Load black vinyl on the standard grip mat and cut the design with the fine-point tool.","Weed away the extra vinyl, keeping only the letters.","Lay transfer tape over the design, burnish, then peel off the paper backing and lift the design.","Center the design on the basswood sheet and press down firmly, then peel away the transfer tape.","Lean the finished sign on a shelf or prop it against the backsplash."],"designTips":"Search your software for 'farmhouse fall word art' or draw simple block letters and weld them together so they cut as one clean piece.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Blade is sharp — weed slowly and keep fingers away from the tip."]},{"title":"Halloween Cork Coaster Set","summary":"Four cork coasters with simple pumpkin, ghost, cat, and moon vinyl silhouettes for the kitchen table.","whyItFits":"Cork coasters and vinyl are both in your stash, and small single-color icons are an easy afternoon project for a comfortable skill level.","difficulty":1,"estMinutes":30,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-20","amount":4,"unit":"piece"},{"supplyId":"sup-01","amount":0.3,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-02","amount":0.2,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":1,"unit":"ft"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Pick four simple 3 inch Halloween icons: pumpkin, ghost, cat, and moon.","Cut one icon from vinyl per coaster using the fine-point tool on your mat.","Weed each design carefully, keeping small details intact.","Use transfer tape to lift each design and center it on a coaster.","Burnish well so the edges stick down completely."],"designTips":"Search 'simple pumpkin silhouette' or 'farmhouse ghost icon' — keep shapes solid and chunky so small vinyl pieces don't lift.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Vinyl is not food or drink safe — coasters should only touch the outside of cups, not food or lips.","Hand wash gently; skip the dishwasher so the vinyl doesn't lift."]},{"title":"Kraft Pennant 'BOO' Banner","summary":"A rustic kraft cardstock pennant banner spelling BOO in glittery gold letters, strung on navy ribbon for a farmhouse kitchen doorway or mantel.","whyItFits":"Combines your kraft cardstock, glitter vinyl, and ribbon into a classic farmhouse banner, using both your cutting tool and scoring tool.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":60,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-11","amount":4,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-05","amount":0.5,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-27","amount":3,"unit":"yd"},{"supplyId":"sup-29","amount":1,"unit":"bottle"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool","scoring-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design a pennant (triangle with a flat top tab) about 5 inches wide and set a score line across the top tab.","Cut four pennants from kraft cardstock, scoring the top fold line at the same time.","Cut the letters B, O, O from gold glitter vinyl, sized to fit the pennants.","Weed the letters and use transfer tape to apply one to each pennant.","Fold each top tab over the ribbon and glue it closed to attach the pennant to the ribbon.","Space the pennants evenly along the ribbon and hang."],"designTips":"Search 'pennant banner template' in your software, or draw a triangle and add a rectangle tab on top, then use the score line tool along the fold.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Glue gun not used here, but let craft glue dry fully before hanging so pennants don't slip off the ribbon."]},{"title":"Felt Pumpkin Garland","summary":"A row of small stuffed-look felt pumpkins with googly eyes and stems, strung on ribbon for a fun farmhouse Halloween garland.","whyItFits":"Uses your rainbow felt sheets and googly eyes for a cozy handmade look, with your printer helping make an accurate template first.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":60,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-10","amount":0.2,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-23","amount":6,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-28","amount":0.2,"unit":"pack"},{"supplyId":"sup-29","amount":1,"unit":"bottle"},{"supplyId":"sup-27","amount":1.5,"unit":"yd"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":["inkjet-printer"],"steps":["Print a simple pumpkin outline about 4 inches tall onto cardstock using your printer.","Cut out the printed template shape using the fine-point tool on cardstock, or trim by hand with scissors.","Trace the template onto felt and cut two pumpkin shapes per pumpkin with scissors (felt is best cut by hand for this project).","Glue the two felt layers together around the edges, tucking a small loop of ribbon at the top before sealing so it can hang.","Glue on googly eyes and a small green felt stem to each pumpkin.","Space three or more pumpkins along a length of ribbon, gluing each in place to finish the garland."],"designTips":"Search 'simple pumpkin outline' for the template shape; keep it chunky and rounded so tracing onto felt is easy.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Small googly eyes are a choking hazard — keep this garland away from children under 3.","Let glue dry fully before hanging so pieces don't fall off."]},{"title":"Farmhouse Plaid Pumpkin Drinkware Set","summary":"Matching vinyl pumpkin decals on a mug, a glass can, and a tumbler for a coordinated Halloween coffee-corner look.","whyItFits":"Uses three of your drinkware blanks plus black, white, and holographic vinyl scraps for a cohesive farmhouse Halloween set without needing any heat equipment.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":45,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-15","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-16","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-17","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-01","amount":0.3,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-02","amount":0.2,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-04","amount":0.1,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":2,"unit":"ft"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design a small pumpkin motif with a plaid-style stem, sized to fit the side of a mug, tumbler, and can.","Cut one design per drinkware item, mixing black, white, and holographic vinyl for layered color.","Weed each design carefully.","Clean and dry each drinkware surface before applying.","Use transfer tape to place each design on the body of the item, staying well below the rim.","Burnish firmly and let the decals set for 24 hours before use."],"designTips":"Search 'layered pumpkin decal' or build a plaid pattern by welding thin rectangles into an X and offsetting a pumpkin outline behind it.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Adhesive vinyl is not food or drink safe — keep all decals below the rim, away from where lips or food touch.","Hand wash these items only; skip the dishwasher and microwave so the vinyl doesn't lift or peel."]}],"note":""}
